Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You adjust the collar and try the little habit that will make the borrowed clothes look lived in.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
Ten minutes preparation; resolve challenges during the encounter.
Target / range / shape
One mundane disguise; ten minutes preparation.
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
Suitable clothing required; none granted.
Limits
Ordinary activities remain available without this card. Roll only when uncertainty has consequences.
Type
Skill / Utility

Use suitable clothing and describe a plausible role. Before a consequential encounter, the DA states the impersonation objective, progress target and whether progress is cumulative. Ordinary unchallenged disguise needs no roll. The card supplies no language, memories or authority.

Weak
1 progress; notice one visible detail of your disguise likely to attract attention.
Standard
2 progress; notice that detail and one observable habit useful to the role.
Strong
3 progress; gain those details and identify one concern the observer expresses about your presence.
